graft.title: Accepting a proposal records a read of claim:<id> that sylva's replay can't find
graft.need: Since rules and decisions became claims (claim:01a15b21-254e), accepting a proposal in sylva writes a `review` op naming `claim:<id>` for each decision in it, but sylva's history holds those decisions as journal entries (journal:<id>), so replay records a conflict and design_review reports `sound: false`. Five batches so far, all titled "read N item(s), as accepted (proposal …)": 01a15b5c-6929..83dd, 01a15b6b-cb27..983d, 01a15b7b-11d0..c9bb, 01a15b9f-a1cc..6fcb, 01a15c35-c590..053f. Example, .tend/log/01a15c35-c590-779d-921e-0b77c446053f.jsonl: {"op":"review","items":[{"of":"claim:01a15bad-4d7a-76ee-a95e-4d7c19685c96",…},{"of":"journal:01a15bad-4d7c-7118-b66d-f98a0f593288",…}]}: the decision 01a15bad-4d7a (journal, kind decision) is reviewed as a claim, the note beside it as journal, and only the claim fails ("not found: claim:01a15bad-4d7a…"). Either the review should name what the repo holds (journal:<id> for a decision not migrated), or the repo's decisions should be migrated to claims so the address resolves; and the five recorded conflicts should clear (the reads they meant to record happened).
graft.use_case: sylva's design should verify clean (design_review sound, `tend check --strict` usable in CI), and what the user has read should count as read, so the reviewed/unreviewed provenance stays true.

answer.text: With the tend deployed now (e4f1f35), sylva's history replays clean: design_review in sylva says no conflicts and sound: true. A decision written as a journal op replays as the claim its read names (claim:<id>), so the five reads resolve and count as read; the conflicts came from the older tend the session ran. A test pins it (tend-core review: a decision written as a journal entry, read as its claim). Restart sylva's session to run the current tend; nothing in sylva's history needs changing.
